text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now, what do you think, Turbo-san!? How's 
this Birthday Special Video made by ace 
director Royce-chan!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible!! It's just like a real TV 
show! I'm so, sooo happy!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm so glad to hear that. After all, 
I was aiming to create an unforgettable 
masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Turbo-san's casual daily life and training 
sessions. And for the race scenes, we'll 
include interviews with Ikuno-san and the 
others to amp up the drama—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, Earth-san's heartfelt 
original BGM will magnificently heighten 
every scene! If I do say so myself, it's 
turned into a masterclass piece.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it was truly heart-stirring work. 
After all, it was a birthday present for a 
dear friend— I poured my soul into it, 
*con anima*.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...Still, though. Royce and Earth weren't 
in that video earlier, were they?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That cannot be helped. We are, so to 
speak, the backstage crew, the *ombra* who 
support from the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No no no, absolutely not~~!! It's no fun 
at all if you guys aren't there! I 
wouldn't be happy about that one bit!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Film Royce and Earth too!! And then edit 
them into the video together!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oops, what an *adorabile* request. What do 
you say, Royce-san?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, that's a piece of cake! Just leave 
it to the brilliant Royce!
